experiences.title: Rydals Herrgård
experiences.story: During our investigation we experienced a sudden temperature drop captured on thermal camera. One of our team members reported a strong presence.

experiences.title: Jugendhouse - Klevs Gästgiveri
experiences.story: Clear footsteps were heard from an empty room next to us. Our thermal camera captured a humanoid form moving along the wall.

experiences.title: Haunted Museum
experiences.story: We saw objects move without anyone touching them. A ball rolled across the floor and back by itself several times.

experiences.title: Hjortsberga
experiences.story: Strong emotional impact when approaching old graves. Team members spontaneously told stories from earlier centuries.

experiences.title: Frammegården
experiences.story: The air became thick and heavy, all instrument activity stopped. Six doors began slamming slowly from upstairs, one after another.

experiences.title: Rankhyttan
experiences.story: Thermal cameras captured several shadow-like forms moving through the rooms. Their movements could be tracked for several minutes.
